title: General Purpose HUD
description: A simple client-side HUD mod designed to be simple yet dynamic
body:
# General Purpose HUD (NeoForge)

General Purpose HUD is a lightweight, client-sided mod that completely redesigns your essential survival overlays—think health bars, hunger bars, air meters, and armor indicators. Built to be simple, dynamic, and clean, it strips away the bulk of the vanilla layout to give you a modern, streamlined look.

This mod is inspired by ExHud, Now on Neoforge for 1.21.1

![Normal Hud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52e1db13fd9e8b13b1ebc5ca8a13bd34c6eaa524.png)

## 🔌 Built to Mix & Match

Unlike massive overhaul mods that try to do everything, General Purpose HUD focuses only on the core survival bars. It is explicitly designed to be modular and used alongside your favorite utility HUD mods (Since this mod removes your armor bar, so... yeah)

## 🌟 Features

Dynamic Numbers: Pulse on low, acknowledge it before you die

Quirky Level: Max display is 999 levels, display Ω for any number past that

Sleek Health Bar: Do i have to break this to you too?

Dual Health Bar When On Mount: Look for it in Gallery

Armor is Hidden: Yes, it's a feature
    
## Currently compatible with:

- Appleskin
- Farmer Delight

If you want to use GPHUD with these mods, make sure to disable their overlays in the their configs
    
## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

###     Will there be a Fabric port?
No. There are currently no plans to port General Purpose HUD to Fabric. If you are playing on Fabric, we highly recommend checking out Exhud, which served as the inspiration for this project!

###     Can I include this in my modpack?
Absolutely! Feel free to include this in any public or private modpacks.
